note: Set A captures the full revision table (five revisions with dates and descriptions), the drawing scale 3/8" = 1'-0" for both sections, and the lot number, all supported by the text layer. Set B omits the entire revision history, the scale, and the project/client information, which are prominent facts on the sheet, though its nine claims are otherwise accurate and it correctly adds the sheet title. Set A's only questionable item is binding 'U.S. DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY SOLAR DECATHLON 2013' as a project name when it appears in the client block as two separate lines. Both sets contain redundant restatements of the grade/finished-floor elevations, but A's coverage of the title block and revision data is decisively more complete.
